items.title: How Writes Work in Apache Cassandra
items.summary: Apache Cassandra is a distributed database designed for high availability and horizontal scalability. It has a write path that involves multiple stages, including writing to the CommitLog, distributing writes across partitions, and using last-write-wins conflict resolution.
